# Image to text · OCR

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/image-to-text/

Extract editable English or Nepali text from a screenshot or photo using local optical character recognition. Copy the result or download a text file.

## How to use it

1. Choose a clear, supported image from your device.
2. Adjust the image settings and run the tool.
3. Inspect the preview, then download or copy the result.

## Example

Turn a clear printed note or screenshot into text you can paste into an editor.

## Limits and checks

The recognition engine and language data download on first use. Handwriting, blur and mixed layouts can reduce accuracy.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Processing runs on the device; an engine or model may download from a third-party CDN. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
